sentences.text:
By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
226 of 2022 at Police Station Buxa, District Jaunpur under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and 3/4 D.P.
Act.
The applicant is in jail since 19.07.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 23.07.2024.

The following arguments made by Shri Shashi Shekhar Maurya, learned counsel for the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agarwal, learned AGA-I from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Suraj Nigam Alias Shiv Prakash Nigam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48607781/

sentences.text: 1. The deceased had separated from first husband.
The applicant was her second husband.
2. The deceased had a traumatic first marriage.
She was depressed on account of trauma she had experienced in her failed marriage.

3. The applicant did not torture the deceased nor demanded dowry.
4.
The applicant had no motive to commit the offence.
5. The postmortem report opined that the cause of death could not be ascertained.
The postmortem report does not depict any ante mortem injuries.
6. The applicant is a law abiding citizen who cooperated in the investigations and has joined the trial proceedings.
7. The applicant never tampered with the evidence nor did he influence any witness.

8. The applicant did not adopt dilatory tactics or impede the trial proceedings.
9.
The trial is moving at a snail's pace and shows no signs of an early conclusion.
The applicant cannot be faulted for the delay in the trial.
10. The right of the applicant to speedy trial has been violated.
11. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen have always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of the applicants influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.

In wake of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case,
the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant - Suraj Nigam Alias Shiv Prakash Nigam be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

entities.text: Suraj Nigam Alias Shiv Prakash Nigam

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
